mapper.select: SELECT staff_id AS staffId, staff_name_kanji AS staffNameKanji, staff_name_furikana AS staffNameFurikana, company_id AS companyId, staff_name_roma AS staffNameRoma, staff_birthday AS staffBirthday, sales_representitive AS salesRepresentitive, operation_start_date AS operationStartDate, operation_end_date AS operationEndDate, latest_evaluation AS latestEvaluation, active_flg AS activeFlg, comment AS commit FROM basic_v2_company_staff WHERE staff_id = #{staffId}
SELECT s.staff_id FROM basic_v2_company_staff s JOIN basic_v2_company_management c ON s.company_id = c.company_id WHERE s.active_flg = 1 AND c.company_abbreviation = 'UCL';
SELECT company_id AS companyId, company_abbreviation AS companyAbbreviation FROM basic_v2_company_management WHERE active_flg = 1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM basic_v2_project_detail WHERE staff_id = #{staffId} AND project_id IS NOT NULL AND active_flg = 1
